title: FilingPulse SEC Signal Extractor Input
description: Configure tickers and signal options. Designed for both direct Apify runs and MCP agent invocation with strict cost guardrails.

tickers.title: Stock Tickers
tickers.description: List of US public equity tickers (e.g., AAPL, NVDA, MSFT) to fetch SEC EDGAR 8-K and Form 4 signals for.

include8k.title: Include Form 8-K Material Events
include8k.description: Extract and classify Form 8-K material items (1.01, 2.02, 4.02, 5.02, 8.01).

includeForm4.title: Include Form 4 Insider Signals
includeForm4.description: Extract Form 4 insider open-market transactions and compute cluster buy/sell scores.

includeMaterialDiff.title: Include 8-K Material Diff Summary
includeMaterialDiff.description: Include deterministic item-level diff against prior 8-K filings per ticker.

maxItems.title: Max Signal Items (MCP Budget Guardrail)
maxItems.description: Hard upper bound on total filing-signal records returned and billed ($0.005 each). Defaults to 20 ($0.10 max) for safe autonomous MCP agent use.

lookbackDays.title: Lookback Window (Days)
lookbackDays.description: Number of calendar days to include when filtering recent SEC filings.

userAgent.title: SEC EDGAR User-Agent Contact
userAgent.description: Optional SEC Fair Access compliant User-Agent string (e.g., 'AppName/1.0 contact@domain.com'). Uses FilingPulse default if omitted.

fixtureMode.title: Offline Deterministic Fixture Mode
fixtureMode.description: When enabled, returns deterministic fixture signals without calling live data.sec.gov endpoints (ideal for integration testing and dry-runs).
